description_en: A rigid oval woven vanity case with hinged lid, stacked removable empty trays and leather top handle. Canonical front: a small blank latch below the top handle. Side view: the deep oval profile and layered lid edge. Rear view: two lid hinges and a smooth woven rear wall. prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: A rigid oval woven vanity case with hinged lid, stacked removable empty trays and leather top handle. Canonical front: a small blank latch below the top handle. Style Rustic: sturdy handmade character and visible bindings. Relative size compact within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: plain over-one-under-one basket weave. Finish: cinnabar red lacquer retaining clearly visible woven strip intersections. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact straight-on FRONT ELEVATION at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature, level with product center. No three-quarter or overhead angle. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
